```bash
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

# Configuration
APP_DIR="/srv/myapp"
RELEASES_DIR="${APP_DIR}/releases"
CURRENT_LINK="${APP_DIR}/current"
LOG_FILE="${APP_DIR}/deploy.log"
HEALTH_URL="http://127.0.0.1:8080/healthz"
HEALTH_TIMEOUT=30
HEALTH_RETRIES=3
HEALTH_INTERVAL=2

# Logging function
log() {
    local timestamp
    timestamp=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
    echo "[${timestamp}] $*" | tee -a "${LOG_FILE}"
}

# Error handler for rollback
cleanup() {
    local exit_code=$?
    if [[ ${exit_code} -ne 0 ]]; then
        log "ERROR: Deployment failed with exit code ${exit_code}"
    fi
}

trap cleanup EXIT

# Validate arguments and prerequisites
main() {
    # Check for release path argument
    if [[ $# -lt 1 ]]; then
        log "ERROR: Usage: $0 <release_timestamp>"
        exit 1
    fi

    local new_release="${RELEASES_DIR}/$1"
    local previous_target=""

    # Verify release directory exists
    if [[ ! -d "${new_release}" ]]; then
        log "ERROR: Release directory not found: ${new_release}"
        exit 1
    fi

    # Ensure current symlink exists and is valid
    if [[ ! -L "${CURRENT_LINK}" ]]; then
        log "ERROR: Current symlink missing: ${CURRENT_LINK}"
        exit 1
    fi

    # Store previous target for rollback
    previous_target=$(readlink "${CURRENT_LINK}")
    log "Previous release target: ${previous_target}"
    log "New release target: ${new_release}"

    # Perform atomic symlink swap
    log "Performing atomic swap..."
    ln -sf "${new_release}" "${CURRENT_LINK}"

    # Health check loop
    log "Running health checks..."
    local health_passed=false
    for ((i=1; i<=HEALTH_RETRIES; i++)); do
        if curl -sf --max-time "${HEALTH_TIMEOUT}" "${HEALTH_URL}" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            log "Health check passed (attempt ${i}/${HEALTH_RETRIES})"
            health_passed=true
            break
        else
            log "Health check failed (attempt ${i}/${HEALTH_RETRIES})"
            sleep "${HEALTH_INTERVAL}"
        fi
    done

    if [[ "${health_passed}" != true ]]; then
        log "ERROR: Health check failed after ${HEALTH_RETRIES} attempts"
        log "ROLLBACK: Restoring previous symlink target"
        ln -sf "${previous_target}" "${CURRENT_LINK}"
        log "ROLLBACK: Previous target restored: ${previous_target}"
        exit 1
    fi

    log "Deployment successful!"
}

main "$@"
```

This script handles the atomic swap, validates prerequisites, performs health checks with retries, and rolls back on failure. It logs all actions and uses proper error handling with `set -euo pipefail`.
